engine: Praat TD-PSOLA via h2_prosody_probe3.psola_resynth (null, pitch targets, DurationTier rate); WORLD analysis only (h2_prosody_probe2.analyse_constrained; target contours from h2_prosody_probe.manipulate(k_phrase, k_tone=1.0, reg_st), its WORLD waveform discarded); dynamics = h2_prosody_probe3.wave_dyn blended in inside the frozen c100 IPs only; level = scalar gain
conditioning: h2_prosody_probe3.highpass (80 Hz, 4th-order zero-phase) + rms_normalize(-26 dBFS whole file); then every item one scalar gain to -26 dBFS RMS over the c100 speech extent (h2_voicefix_gen.speech_edges, 35-dB gate, frozen per cell; x 1/rate on rate items); lvl+6 = on-disk c100 x 10^(6/20); effort = on-disk effort0 x 10^(7/20); 0.98 peak guard (flagged when engaged); PCM_16 at the source sample rate
phrase_layer: log-F0, unvoiced gaps interpolated, 400-ms Hann smooth around the voiced median; tone = residual; k_tone = 1.0

references.tgt100: PSOLA with the unchanged analysis contour imposed as target (floor of every target rung)
references.effort0: effort composite at the common -26 dBFS (level-equalised twin of effort; diagnostic)
references.lvl+6: gain-knob diagnostic, not a counted rung (plan section 2.2 G2)

frozen_structure: ${PROJECT_ROOT}/pipeline/prosody_ladder/_explore/voicedose/ladder2/structure/<cell>.json (features_v2.structure on c100, computed once; rate_maps for rate rungs)
time_maps: ${PROJECT_ROOT}/pipeline/prosody_ladder/_explore/voicedose/ladder2/timemap/<cell>__<rung>.json (rate rungs: design map, measured envelope scale, nucleus pairs, frame index arrays at 30 and 60 fps)

measures.realised_k: LS slope of the item's phrase layer on c100's; harvest (union range) + clean_f0; frames voiced in the analysis contour and in both tracks; rate items mapped onto c100's frames first
measures.realised_k_praat: the same with Praat To Pitch (ac)
measures.register_st_praat: median frame-wise 12*log2(item/c100), Praat, frozen frame set (harvest: register_st_harvest)
measures.realised_time_scale_env: s maximising corr(c100 10-ms dB envelope, item envelope at t/s) over the c100 speech extent; rate items should read 0.90
measures.nucleus_align: frozen c100 v2 nuclei mapped by 1/rate vs nuclei detected on the item with the frozen profile (nearest within 80 ms)
measures.adj_step_rms_st_praat: RMS of register steps between consecutive syllables of the same IP (frozen c100 syllables; syllable register = mean st of Praat-voiced frames); adj_step_ratio_praat = / c100; target.design_adj_step_ratio = same on the target contour vs the analysis contour
measures.phrase_span_st: p90-p10 of the phrase layer over the frozen frame set (st); span_ratio = / c100
measures.env_sd_db: rate 1: h2_prosody_probe2.measures(mask_ref=c100); rate items: envelope mapped onto c100 frames with the c100 gate; realised_g = / c100
measures.env_sd_db_ref_extent: the same restricted to the c100 speech extent (realised_g_extent)
measures.nonspeech_rms_vs_c100_db: RMS outside the (mapped) c100 speech extent, item minus c100 (dB)
measures.pause_rms_vs_c100_db: RMS inside the c100 speech extent but outside the frozen c100 IPs, item minus c100 (rate-1 items)
measures.tone_r_vs_c100: Pearson r of the tone layer vs c100's on frames voiced in both (harvest; _praat = Praat)
measures.design_beta: h2_prosody_probe2.design_beta(analysis F0, target F0); F0-shape-untouched items must be 1.000
measures.delivery_err_med_st: median |realised - target| st on frames voiced in both
measures.human_cues: human/acoustic.one() scalar definitions (16 kHz, extract_prosody F0, acoustic.speech_span) on the item; vs_c100 = deltas / ratios
measures.lilthead_view: lilthead/extract_prosody.features(y, sr, 60): the v1 model's own tracker and p99 energy reference; rate items mapped onto c100's frames; realised_k / realised_g against c100's tracks
measures.realised_k_pyin: LS slope of the phrase layer on c100's, librosa pyin (16 kHz, 5-ms hop, cell tracker range), frozen frame set
measures.register_st_pyin: median frame-wise 12*log2(item/c100) under pyin, frozen frame set
measures.adj_step_ratio_pyin: adjacent-syllable register-step RMS (same IP, frozen c100 syllables) under pyin / c100's
measures.d_f0_span_st_praat: p90-p10 F0 span (Praat, frozen frame set) minus c100's
measures.shr_ratio_vs_c100: median subharmonic-to-harmonic amplitude ratio (k=1..4, 40-ms Hann, Praat-voiced frames, item time) / c100's
measures.verdict: ok | warn | fail | reference, with reasons (verify_pyin.verdicts)
